specials.title: Reddog Piney Creek Specials
specials.description:
Soup
- Creamy New England Clam Chowder - tender clams, crispy bacon, and perfectly cooked potatoes in a rich,  creamy broth. 

Appetizer
- Baba Ganoush & Hummus Plate- Creamy, smoky eggplant dip with tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, and garlic, paired with our house made Hummus. Served with sliced carrots, cucumbers and toasted pita bread. 14

Mains 
	- Salsa Verde Stacked Chicken Enchiladas –
 Shredded chicken, Salsa Verde, and sour cream stacked and smothered in cheese. 22

Lunch Special Fri/Sat
- Bacon Jam Cheese Smashburger – our signature beef blend smashed with melted American cheese, 
topped with our sweet, tangy house made bacon jam. 14
